title: VTA Attestation — Mnemonic Export — payload
description: Asks an agent running in a trusted execution environment to release its seed mnemonic, once, sealed to the producer's ephemeral key. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

clientDid.description: The producer's ephemeral Ed25519 did:key. The mnemonic is sealed to its X25519 counterpart, so only the holder of this key's private half can open the answer. Ephemeral by intent: a key generated for this one export, on the machine that will hold the backup, and discarded after.

nonce.description: Sixteen random bytes, base64url without padding. It becomes the sealed bundle's identifier, and the recipient binds it into its attestation quote, so an answer cannot be replayed to a different request.

label.description: Operator-visible label for the request. Never sealed into the answer and never treated as an instruction.

Response.title: VTA Attestation Mnemonic Export — response payload

bundle.description: The ASCII-armored sealed bundle. It carries the mnemonic sealed to clientDid under a producer assertion whose attestation quote binds the client key, the nonce and the recipient's own sealing key.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the bundle, lowercase hex. The producer confirms it out of band before opening, so a substituted bundle is caught before any key is applied to it.

windowRemainingSecs.description: Seconds that were left in the export window when the mnemonic was released. Informational: the window is spent either way.
